current_activity: directing defence from Army Group B HQ
notes: Rommel's Army Group B (re-formed) covered Netherlands to Loire; reserves incl. 2nd, 21st and 116th Panzer Divisions. Army Group B released 21st Panzer Division to Seventh Army at 05:00 on 6 June. HQ at Chateau de La Roche-Guyon; Rommel was in Germany on 6 June and returned to the HQ about 22:00 that night.

current_activity: requesting 7th Army withdrawal toward the Seine
notes: After Epsom, Rommel on 29 June asked Hitler for permission for the 7th Army to start a fighting withdrawal toward the Seine; Hitler later demanded unyielding defence. (Rommel and Rundstedt had been summoned to see Hitler at Berchtesgaden around 28 June per CMH/Epsom; position shown is Army Group B HQ, not Rommel s location.)

current_activity: Rommel badly injured; Kluge, the OB West commander, takes over Army Group B as well
notes: Event date: Rommel was injured in a car accident on the afternoon of 17 July when an Allied plane strafed his car; that evening, when the news became known, Kluge assumed command of Army Group B in addition to OB West (Breakout and Pursuit ch. 8 p. 169). Wikipedia's Army Group B page gives Kluge as commander from 17 July. Event support: the event itself is stated in the cited text (see Event date); only the headquarters place is a representative point. Location support fallback: no source read gives the headquarters place for 17 July; the point is the Chateau de La Roche-Guyon, the headquarters of claims C0011 and C0202, used as a representative point.

current_activity: Model takes over Army Group B (and OB West) from Kluge
notes: Event date: Wikipedia's Army Group B page lists Model as commander from 17 August 1944 (Hausser acting 15 to 17 August) and its OB West page lists Model as acting commander from 17 August. The CMH Green Book (Breakout and Pursuit ch. 27 p. 532, 535, row of G018) puts the assumption of command at midnight after 18 August. The sources do not agree and neither is judged better, so both rows are disputed. Event support: the event itself is stated in the cited text (see Event date); only the headquarters place is a representative point. Location support fallback: the point is La Roche-Guyon, the headquarters of claims C0011 and C0202, used as a representative point.

current_activity: Model takes over OB West and Army Group B; Kluge leaves for Germany
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 27 p. 532 calls Model the commander-designate of OB West and Army Group B when he drove to the Fifth Panzer Army command post near Lisieux at 0600 on 18 August; p. 535 says that 'Model at midnight, after a day of inspection and conference in the west, assumed command'. The row reads that midnight as the end of 18 August, the date entered here (the text does not give the date; inferred from the two passages). Review (inferred value): the date 19 August is inferred; Wikipedia gives 17 August (G018 alternate). The sources do not agree and neither is judged better, so both rows are disputed. Event support: the event itself is stated in the cited text (see Event date); only the headquarters place is a representative point. Location support fallback: no source read gives the headquarters place for 18 or 19 August; the point is La Roche-Guyon, the headquarters of claims C0011 and C0202, used as a representative point.
